mandate: C314 — test the SPOT-PERP LEAD-LAG statistical-arbitrage family on USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (2304 pre-registered configs). Signal: cross-sectional lead-lag between the same asset's spot and perp 5m returns; long-perp/short-spot the strongest spot-leads-perp names and the reverse for the weakest. 2-leg USDT PnL with costs charged on BOTH legs (symmetric and perp_heavy variants). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), DSR/MDE, sub-period stability, and lead-lag-vs-noise attribution.

methodology.signal: leadlag = max_k corr(spot[t-k],perp[t]) - max_k corr(perp[t-k],spot[t]); rolling corr window 288 bars; threshold + cross-sectional tercile/quartile.
methodology.pnl: 2-leg USDT: pnl = sum_i pos_i * spread_ret_i, spread_ret = perp_ret - spot_ret.
methodology.costs: charged on BOTH legs on turnover; symmetric = 2*(fee+slip); perp_heavy = (fee+slip)+(1.5*fee+slip).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs flat (0); Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 2304 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: reference config vs placebo (per-asset randomly-lagged perp returns); leadlag_vs_noise_share = |ref_net|/(|ref_net|+|placebo_net|).
methodology.funding: USDT-M funding unreachable (fapi 451, not in archives) -> excluded (control only).
